Rule.name: Mock-WebService-BeforeOperation-ModifyBody
Rule.Description: This rule is executed before Web Services provisioning operations. It intercepts the REST request body, parses the payload JSON, validates account creation parameters, fetches live target group arrays via restClient, and enforces role-dependency business rules.

Argument.name: requestEndPoint
Argument.Description: The current request information containing headers, body, context URL, and method type.

Argument.name: oldResponseMap
Argument.Description: Earlier response object map, if applicable.

Argument.name: restClient
Argument.Description: REST Client Object used to execute secondary internal HTTP operations.

Argument.name: EndPoint
Argument.Description: Updated EndPoint Object with mutated payload body mapping configurations.
